cec.fallback_rule: if human agreement on 30 Dev cases < 0.80, budgeted nDCG@10 becomes RQ2 primary

version_check.keep: any of the RQ1 extractors (5, or 6 with GROBID) finds >= 0.70 of the evidence paragraphs; v1 used when latest is missing or matches worse

hardware.note: historical results were reported on Ryzen 5 5600; latency is only compared within new runs

memory_definition: peak working set (Windows RSS) of the Python process and summed over the Ollama process tree, sampled every 0.1 s, reported separately

peerqa.pdfs: 8 EGU automatic + 102 OpenReview saved manually in a browser (OpenReview blocks automated access)
